convention: World = sim/block_poses frame (metres). Camera pose given as USD xformOp translate (mm) and orient quaternion (w, x, y, z), USD camera axes (-Z forward, +Y up); OpenCV camera rotation = R_usd @ diag(1,-1,-1). Projection u = K X_cam; stored dataset JPEGs and online arrays of the external cameras are rotated 180 deg relative to the raw render, so u_stored = (W-1, H-1) - u_raw (rotate_180 below).

sources.intrinsics: HDF5 sim attrs provenance_json -> cameras[*].{low,high}.intrinsic_matrix_k (every episode of the local release; identical in TOWER-Assets tasks/tower_insertion_2.json expected_cameras)
sources.extrinsics: TOWER-Assets station/station-update-20260913.json, changes for /PNP_DUALD1200_STATION/CameraAlignment/{low,high}_camera xformOp:translate / xformOp:orient
sources.camera_name_mapping: left_back_camera = low, right_front_camera = high: verified by reprojection, silhouette IoU 0.90-0.95 and residual shift <= 3 px on frame 0 of all ten variants (runs/spatial/calib_check.txt)
sources.fixed_online: challenge docs task-prompts: 'The foundation blocks, table, robot mounts, robot dynamics, camera calibration, and destination anchors stay fixed.'

estimator.note: jenga.offset.OffsetEstimator score = silhouette correlation + edge_weight x grey-gradient map along the visible edges of the movable blocks. 0 = silhouette only. Chosen on synthetic rule-box shifts of 30 train episodes per variant (edge_weight 0/1/2/3/5): mean per-variant gated footprint p95 8.5/4.3/4.0/4.1/4.4 mm, worst 38.3/8.2/8.4/8.4/8.9 mm. layouts[*].estimator_bias and offset_gate are fitted for this value.
estimator.note_photometric: Each external image is mapped to the variant's nominal per-channel tone (layouts[*].photometric_reference at photometric_levels, fitted y = a x^b per channel; jenga.offset.normalise) before the wood mask and edge map; pixels with a clipped channel are ignored by the silhouette score and the confidence. saturated_gate: when more than min_fraction of a camera's search ROI is clipped (gain ~2: lit wood faces saturate) the yaw gate is raised to yaw_deg_min. Measured in runs/spatial/validate/l.json.

layouts.note: mean sim/block_poses[0] over the train split, pose = xyz + quaternion xyzw (world). Generated by scripts/fit_kinematics.py
